name: EX5-LAYERMATCH-0
note: The missing EX4-UNIF control cell: fixed layer profile, rank-unrestricted identity. Delta_m = sum over eval seeds 4001/5002/6003 of (gate_m - gate_full), per mask; a mask CLEARS a bar when its Delta meets the threshold AND its per-seed deltas are 3/3 same-sign. Masks are the mechanism replication unit (n_mask=3 per family); eval seeds are paired repeats; the 24 cells are never n=24 independent evidence. INTERPRETATION FENCE (registered): rank-window masks also delete ~2x the pooled demand of layer-only masks (manifest: 2.35-2.60% v 1.26-1.42% demand share), so a family separation reads 'rank-window/high-demand selection matters beyond layer placement', never 'rank rank-causally isolated'. Bar 8 DRAW-SPREAD is diagnostic: its FIRE flags a family read as draw-dominated but does NOT suppress bar 3 when bar 3's non-overlap conjunct holds. Bar 7 RANK-TRANSPORT is a non-suppressing range prediction on the historical +28 (rand0), not an instrument anchor.

full128.description: all-128 keepset (checkpoints/ex1_full128.json), the paired baseline in every Delta

rank0.description: fresh rank-window-matched mask ex5_del_rank0 (seed ex5-rank-0, manifest sha)

bars.name: QUALIFICATION
bars.description: seed-1001 full128 must reproduce 59 and old ex3_del_rand0 must reproduce 70, cell-exact, on the pinned re-downloaded snapshot. Any mismatch = INSTRUMENT-INVALID, EX5 aborts pre-treatment, pivot to STABILITY-ATLAS.

bars.name: LAYER-GENERIC
bars.description: >=2/3 layer masks each Delta >= +21 with per-seed signs 3/3: layer-profile deletion alone helps.

bars.name: RANK-FAMILY
bars.description: >=2/3 rank masks each Delta >= +21 with signs 3/3: was historical rand0 a lucky mask?

bars.name: FAMILY-SEPARATION
bars.description: median(rank Delta) - median(layer Delta) >= +21 AND min(rank Delta) > max(layer Delta) (non-overlap conjunct, margin >= 1). Median clearing with overlapping ranges books as direction-only, not a FIRE.

bars.name: NAMED-CREST
bars.description: named80 - full >= +21 pooled with signs 3/3 on the fresh triple: the crest itself replicates off seeds 1001/2002/3003.

bars.name: IDENTITY-PREMIUM
bars.description: for >=2/3 rank masks, pooled (named80 - rank_mask) >= +21 with signs 3/3: carrier identity beats its own rank class.

bars.name: RANK-TRANSPORT
bars.description: non-suppressing range prediction: |median(rank Delta) - 28| <= 10 (the booked rand0 read transports to fresh masks and fresh seeds). An excursion is a result, never an instrument alarm.

bars.name: DRAW-SPREAD
bars.description: diagnostic: within-family mask range >= 21 in either family flags that family's read as draw-dominated (the unif0/unif1 lesson as a registered gate). Does NOT suppress bar 4 when bar 4's non-overlap conjunct holds.

refuted_if: The rank-local over-inclusion hypothesis is REFUTED if the rank family clears (bar 3 FIRES) while family separation fails at the resolution floor: median(rank Delta) - median(layer Delta) < 10 (below the ~1.5-sigma house pair resolution) — i.e. layer placement + count reproduces the rank-matched benefit and over-inclusion is generic at this layer profile, not rank-local. Adjudicated only when the sanity qualification holds (precedence).
registered_prior: House, on the record: bar 1 passes exact (the gate reproduced zero-drift once before, EX4-UNIF riders); bar 5 fires (crest is real, +55 on the old triple); bar 3 fires at 2/3 or 3/3 with medians in the high teens-to-high-20s (rand0/rand1 class transports); bar 2 does NOT fire (layer family lands 0 to low teens, at least one mask near zero); bar 4 fires on median but the non-overlap conjunct is genuinely uncertain (coin flip); bar 7 holds; bar 8 fires for the layer family (uniform draws spread, the unif0/unif1 precedent). Net prediction: rank-window/high-demand selection matters beyond layer placement, and the refutation predicate does NOT trip.
